entry.title: SamplerFilter 1.1.4
entry.summary: ## What's new - Rebuilt on the current [open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins](https://github.com/open-mpc/mpc-vst-plugins) toolkit, including the wrapper fix for small buffer sizes (input and output sharing one buffer). - The plugin folder carries a `plugin.json`, so on MPC OS 3.10.1 it can be copied by hand into `VST2 Plugins`. - New: `SamplerFilter-1.1.4-mpc-sdk.zip`, the Akai SDK folder format (MPC OS 3.10.1 and later). entry.title: SamplerFilter 1.1.3
entry.summary: A vintage-sampler 6-pole low-pass filter with bit and sample-rate reduction. A native MPC OS plugin (effect) with its own MPC screen skin, loaded by MPC's built-in plugin host. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61).
